stemMarkdown: Let $f(x) = 2x + 3$ and $g(x) = x - 1$. Find the value of $(f \circ g)(4)$.
solutionMarkdown: First, we find $g(4)$: \[ g(4) = 4 - 1 = 3. \] Next, we evaluate $f(g(4))$: \[ f(g(4)) = f(3). \] Using the definition of $f(x)$: \[ f(3) = 2(3) + 3 = 6 + 3 = 9. \]
altSolutionMarkdown: Since $(f \circ g)(x) = f(g(x))$, first calculate $g(4)$, then plug that value into $f$. This yields: \[ (f \circ g)(4) = 2(4-1) + 3 = 9.\]
